prompt: Edit the supplied transparent painted information icon to create ONE matching Ask/Question icon asset for this same native mobile app. The supplied PNG is the exact style and frame reference. Keep its circular brass/ochre rim, cream parchment disc, warm brown hand-painted outline, matte watercolor grain, frontal composition, lighting and colors essentially identical. Replace ONLY the lowercase information letter i and its separate upper dot with one centered bold warm burnt-ochre question mark (?) with a separate round dot beneath it. The question mark is the sole symbol: no word, no caption, no other letters or numbers. Center its visible shape evenly inside the disc; the punctuation should read cleanly at 30 logical pixels. Preserve the round signboard at a centered square canvas with equal transparent margins and full rim inside the canvas. Genuine transparent RGBA outside the disc, no tile, scenery, cast shadow, glow, glossy metal, checkerboard or watermark. This is an individual shipped icon, not a UI mockup. Maintain the exact muted warm pigment family and restrained painterly texture of the reference.
method: built-in image_gen, transparent edit of info.png
packaging: Crop alpha>=8; uniformly resize to longest432px; center on transparent512px; clear alpha<8; 256-color alpha PNG

final.name: question
